T: Adopt a kid. Feed him whatever he wants.
D: A lazy New Yorker adopts a five-year-old to win back his girlfriend and makes up the parenting rules as he goes.
P: Serve the wings when Sonny takes Julian out to the sports bar.
S: Sonny taking Julian out to the sports bar

Sticky smoky barbecue wings with a sweet heat glaze, scattered with spring onion and served with a cool ranch dip. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once. Simmer 200ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp hot sauce for 3 minutes and toss the wings through, then bake 5 minutes more. Mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and garlic powder for the ranch. Scatter wings with spring onion.

Toasted mini bagels with whipped scallion cream cheese, crisp bacon and a sprinkle of homemade everything seasoning. Mix 1 tbsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp poppy seeds, 1 tsp dried onion flakes, 1/2 tsp garlic flakes and 1/2 tsp sea salt. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 sliced spring onions until fluffy. Grill 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Split and toast 12 mini bagels. Spread with the cream cheese, top with bacon and sprinkle with the seasoning.
M: Sonny's one day a week at the tollbooth

Smashed beef patties with melted cheese in toasted buns, with a build-your-own bar of pickles, bacon, onion rings, sauces and crinkle fries. Bake 800g frozen crinkle-cut chips and 300g frozen onion rings at 220C for 25 minutes. Grill 6 rashers bacon. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls, smash flat in a very hot oiled pan, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top with cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Set out lettuce, tomato, pickles, bacon, onion rings, tomato sauce, mustard and mayonnaise and let everyone build their own.
W: Julian and his favourite toy, Scuba Steve

Vanilla ice cream with blue jelly cubes, whipped cream, crushed biscuit sand, gummy fish and chocolate sauce, an under-the-sea sundae. Make 1 packet blue jelly with 500ml boiling water, set in a shallow dish for 3 hours and cut into cubes. Crush 6 plain sweet biscuits into sand. In 4 tall glasses, layer jelly cubes, 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and more jelly. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, a sprinkle of biscuit sand, a few gummy fish and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.
K: Julian, who wants to be called Frankenstein

Thick chocolate malt milkshakes with ice cream, whipped cream and a drizzle of chocolate sauce, served with striped straws. Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes and drizzle chocolate sauce down the insides. Blend 600ml cold milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp chocolate malt powder and 2 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and sprinkle with a little more malt powder.
